MRP from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/120396 (unrelated issue), seems to be crashing in 100% cases (open the editor, run project, stop project, close the editor).

Here's the set of event leading to the crash (with this PR):

```
Timestamp   Event                           Thread ID       Data

....

7261662     shader_cache_free_entry         1               key: 0                                  <-- CRASH
```

Thanks @bruvzg - I will test the MRP!
